payload.claim: Criterion 1's acceptance text says the export's network 'creates through runtime.create_network,' while the Notes for the agent ('The network') instruct 'Claim it with runtime.allocate_network.' Both functions exist and are compatible (allocate_network is implemented in terms of create_network, matching the existing saffron/phases/package.py:578-612 pattern the Notes cite, and the witness stubbing of networks_on_subnet alongside create_network only makes sense if allocate_network's retry logic is exercised), so this is not a contradiction in practice, only an imprecise choice of words in the acceptance claim.
